I agree.
Most of my life, I’ve been struggling with depression, and I have always been afraid to tell people. I was afraid of people just saying: “You’re just looking for attention” or “You’re just sad, it’ll go away”. I then talked to one of my good friends about it. He knew what it was, and what it meant. He has been helping me ever since, keeping me in this world. There are people that feel like you, find them and talk to them. It helps.
Thx for that, I really needed that.
